spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Tame, domesticated, as a bird or beast.
2 Citizen, town-bred, rakish, buckish, smart, trained in the acuteness and vice of towns.
E.
छो to cut, affix ईकन, deriv. irr.

f. (-क्तिः)
Indirect speech, insinuation, double entendre, hint, &c.
E.
छेक city-bred, and उक्ति saying.
